CrossCodex E2E Test Catalog - Unstructured Text Format

Section 1: Access Control

AC-1 Access Control Policy and Procedures
Organizations shall develop, document, and disseminate access control policies
that address purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, and compliance. The policy
must be reviewed and updated annually.

AC-2 Account Management
Organizations shall manage system accounts including creation, modification,
enablement, disablement, and removal. Account types include individual, group,
system, application, guest, and temporary accounts.

AC-3 Access Enforcement
The information system enforces approved authorizations for logical access to
information and system resources in accordance with applicable access control
policies. This includes role-based, attribute-based, and mandatory access controls.

Section 2: Awareness and Training

AT-1 Security Awareness and Training Policy
Organizations shall develop security awareness training programs for all personnel
including contractors. Training must cover security basics, threat awareness, and
incident reporting procedures. Training shall be provided before granting access
and annually thereafter.
